AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Paper burning to ash

3. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Rearing Selected Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Rearing Selected Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Rearing Selected Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Rearing Selected Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Rearing Selected Animals.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Pest control? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Pest control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Pest control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Pest control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Pest control.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.

13. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Livestock Products? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Livestock Products.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Livestock Products.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Livestock Products.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Livestock Products.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Digestive systems of animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Digestive systems of animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Digestive systems of animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Digestive systems of animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Digestive systems of animals.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Powered Tools and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Management of Agro- byproducts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Agri- business Accounts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Inorganic fertilisers and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Water conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetative propagation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
